title_en: Batman Will Team Up With Batman as Bruce Wayne and Jace Fox Finally Join Forces in 2027's Batman: Reign of Assassins
summary_en: Get ready for a double dose of Batman, as Bruce Wayne and Jace Fox finally team up in 2027's Batman: Reign of Assassins.
body_en:
If you're out of the loop with DC's comic book universe, you might not be aware that there are currently two versions of the Dark Knight - Bruce Wayne and Jace Fox. Those two heroes are finally having their first big team-up in a new miniseries called Batman: Reign of Assassins.
Check out the slideshow gallery below to see an early preview of Batman: Reign of Assassins #1:
Had things originally gone as planned with DC's canceled 5G reboot , Lucius Fox's son Jace would have officially taken the mantle of Batman in the DC Universe. Instead, Bruce and Jace currently share that mantle, with Bruce remaining in his traditional stomping grounds of Gotham City and Jace finally giving New York City the costumed hero it had been lacking.
Reign of Assassins will pair Bruce and Jace with Katana as the three heroes embark on a globetrotting adventure against a mysterious new enemy. The series is written by John Ridley and drawn by Olivier Coipel, who previously cemented Jace's new status quo as Batman in 2021's I Am Batman . The creative team also includes colorist Mat Lopes and letterer AndWorld Design.
Batman: Reign of Assassins is a five-issue series, with issue #1 due in stores on February 17, 2027. You can preorder a copy at your local comic shop .
In other Batman news, the animated movie Batman: Knightfall Part 2 - Knightquest is releasing on December 15 .
